H6206.d: a primitive root; to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass; be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.
r: if so be thou mayest prevail

H6187.d: from עָרַךְ; a pile, equipment, estimate; equal, estimation, (things that are set in) order, price, proportion, [idiom] set at, suit, taxation, [idiom] valuest.
r: things that are to be set in order

H6080.d: ; a primitive root; meaning either to be gray or perhaps rather to pulverize; used only as denominative from עָפָר,; to be dust; cast (dust).

H6461.d: a primitive root; probably to disperse, i.e. (intransitive) disappear; cease.

H6337.d: from פָּזַז; pure (gold); hence, gold itself (as refined); fine (pure) gold.

H6304.d: or פְּדֻת; from קֵדְמָהlemma קדְמָה missing vowel, corrected to קֵדְמָה; distinction; also deliverance; division, redeem, redemption.

H6001.d: from עָמַל; toiling; concretely, a laborer; figuratively, sorrowful; that laboureth, that is a misery, had taken (labour), wicked, workman.

H6055.d: from עָנַן and יָהּ; Jah has covered; Ananjah, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine; Ananiah.

H6064.d: a primitive root; properly, to urge; by implication, to inflict apenalty, specifically, to fine; amerce, condemn, punish, [idiom] surely.

H6303.d: from פָּדָה; ransom; Padon, one of the Nethinim.; Padon.

H6339.d: a primitive root (identical with פָּזַז); to solidify (as if by refining); also to spring (as if separating the limbs); leap, be made strong.

H6131.d: a primitive root; to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically, to hamstring; figuratively, to exterminate; dig down, hough, pluck up, root up.

H6112.d: from an unused root meaning to be sharp or strong; a spear; Eznite (from the margin).

H6458.d: a primitive root; to carve, whether wood or stone; grave, hew.

H6138.d: from עָקַר; eradication; Ekron, a place in Palestine; Ekron.

H6108.d: from עָצַם; power; hence, body; might, strong, substance.

H6160.d: from עָרַב (in the sense of sterility); a desert; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea; Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה.

H6232.d: from עָשַׁק; oppression; Eshek, an Israelite; Eshek.

H6357.d: of foreign derivation; a gem, probably the topaz; topaz.

H6165.d: a primitive root; to long for; cry, pant.

H6088.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to עָצַב; to afflict; lamentable.

H6034.d: probably from עָנָה; an answer; Anah, the name of two Edomites and one Edomitess; Anah.

H6362.d: a primitive root; to cleave or burst through, i.e. (causatively) to emit, whether literal or figurative (gape); dismiss, free, let (shoot) out, slip away.

H6184.d: from עָרַץ; fearful, i.e. powerful or tyrannical; mighty, oppressor, in great power, strong, terrible, violent.

H6273.d: from an unused root meaning to force; forcible; Othni, an Israelite; Othni.

H6295.d: from פֶּגַע and אֵל; accident of God; Pagiel, an Israelite; Pagiel.

H6099.d: or עָצֻם; passive participle of עָצַם; powerful (specifically, a paw); by implication, numerous; [phrase] feeble, great, mighty, must, strong.

H6162.d: from עָרַב (in the sense of exchange); a pawn (given as security); pledge.

H6179.d: from עוּר; watchful; Eri, an Israelite; Eri.

H6076.d: from עָפַל; a tumor; also a mound, i.e. fortress; emerod, fort, strong hold, tower.

H6245.d: a primitive root; probably to be sleek, i.e. glossy; hence (through the idea of polishing) to excogitate (as if forming in the mind); shine, think.

H6280.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) abundant; deceitful, multiply.

H6328.d: a primitive root; to waver; stumble, move.

H6335.d: a primitive root; to spread; figuratively, act proudly; grow up, be grown fat, spread selves, be scattered.

H6276.d: from עָתַק; antique, i.e. valued; durable.

H6275.d: a primitive root; to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe; copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove.

H6021.d: from עָמַס; burden; Amasa, the name of two Israelites; Amasa.

H6320.d: from an unused root meaning to paint; dye (specifically, stibium for the eyes); fair colours, glistering, paint(-ed) (-ing).

H6265.d: from עוּת and יָהּ; Jah has helped; Athajah, an Israelite; Athaiah.

H6175.d: passive participle of עָרַם; cunning (usually in a bad sense); crafty, prudent, subtil.

H6407.d: patronymically from פַּלְטִי; a Paltite or descendant of Palti; Paltite.

H6431.d: from an unused root meaning to flee; swiftness; Peleth, the name of two Israelites; Peleth.

H6363.d: or פִּטְרָה; from פָּטַר; a fissure, i.e. (concretely) firstling (as opening the matrix); firstling, openeth, such as open.

H6356.d: from the same as פַּחַת; a hole (by mildew in a garment); fret inward.

H6029.d: a primitive root; to lace fast; bind, tie.

H6447.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to פָּסַס; the palm (of the hand, as being spread out); participle

H6191.d: a primitive root; properly, to be (or make) bare; but used only in the derivative sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) to be cunning (usually in a bad sense); [idiom] very, beware, take crafty (counsel), be prudent, deal subtilly.

H6135.d: from עָקַר; sterile (as if extirpated in the generative organs); ([idiom] male or female) barren (woman).

H6169.d: feminine from עָרָה; a naked (i.e. level) plot; paper reed.

H6381.d: a primitive root; properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful; accomplish, (arise...too, be too) hard, hidden, things too high, (be, do, do a, shew) marvelous(-ly, -els, things, work), miracles, perform, separate, make singular, (be, great, make) wonderful(-ers, -ly, things, works), wondrous (things, works, -ly).

H6182.d: from an unused root meaning to comminute; meal; dough.

H6155.d: from עָרַב; a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles); willow.

H6218.d: or עָשֹׂר; from עֶשֶׂר; ten; by abbreviated form ten strings, and so a decachord; (instrument of) ten (strings, -th).

H6403.d: a primitive root; to slip out, i.e. escape; causatively, to deliver; calve, carry away safe, deliver, (cause to) escape.

H6382.d: from פָּלָא; a miracle; marvellous thing, wonder(-ful, -fully).

H6141.d: from עָקַשׁ; distorted; hence, false; crooked, froward, perverse.

H6186.d: a primitive root; to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications); put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert (in war), furnish, handle, join (battle), ordain, (lay, put, reckon up, set) (in) order, prepare, tax, value.

H6120.d: from עָקַב in its denominative sense; a lier in wait; heel (by mistake for עָקֵב).

H6480.d: a primitive root; to rend (by earthquake); break.

H6210.d: from an unused root meaning perhaps to arch; a couch (properly, with a canopy); bed(-stead), couch.

H6257.d: a primitive root; to prepare; make fit, be ready to become.

H6177.d: or עֲרֹעֵר; or עַרְעוֹר; the same as עֲרוֹעֵר; nudity of situation; Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine; Aroer.

H6017.d: from עָמַר; a (ruined) heap; Amorah, a place in Palestine; Gomorrah.

H6441.d: from פָּנִים with directive enclitic; faceward, i.e. indoors; (with-) in(-ner part, -ward).

H6221.d: from עָשָׂה and אֵל; made of God; Asiel, an Israelite; Asiel.

H6067.d: from עָנָה; answer; Anath, an Israelite; Anath.

H6307.d: from an unused root meaning to extend; a plateau; or פַּדַּן אֲרָם; from the same and אֲרָם; the table-land of Aram; Paddan or Paddan-Aram, a region of Syria; Padan, Padan-aram.

H6470.d: a primitive root; to tap, i.e. beat regularly; hence (generally) to impel or agitate; move, trouble.

H6424.d: a primitive root; properly, to roll flat, i.e. prepare (a road); also to revolve, i.e. weigh (mentally); make, ponder, weigh.

H6487.d: from פָּקַד; a deposit; that which was delivered (to keep), store.

H6233.d: from עָשַׁק; injury, fraud, (subjectively) distress, (concretely) unjust gain; cruelly, extortion, oppression, thing (deceitfully gotten).

H6277.d: from עָתַק in the sense of license; impudent; arrogancy, grievous (hard) things, stiff.

H6246.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to עָשַׁת; to purpose; think.

H6075.d: a primitive root; to swell; figuratively, be elated; be lifted up, presume.

H6183.d: from עָרַף; the sky (as dropping at the horizon); heaven.

H6044.d: for plural of עַיִן; fountains; Anim, a place in Palestine; Anim.

H6237.d: a primitive root (identical with עָשַׁר); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from עֶשֶׂר; to tithe, i.e. to take or give atenth; [idiom] surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), [idiom] truly.

H6418.d: from an unused root meaning to be round; a circuit (i.e. district); also a spindle (as whirled); hence, a crutch; (di-) staff, participle

H6401.d: from פֶּלַח; slicing; Pilcha, an Israelite; Pilcha.

H6345.d: feminine of פַּחַד; alarm (i.e. awe); fear.

H6147.d: from עוּר; watchful; Er, the name of two Israelites; Er.

H6331.d: a primitive root; to crush; break, bring to nought, [idiom] utterly take.

H6471.d: or (feminine) פַּעֲמָה; from פָּעַם; a stroke, literally or figuratively (in various applications, as follow); anvil, corner, foot(-step), going, (hundred-) fold, [idiom] now, (this) [phrase] once, order, rank, step, [phrase] thrice, (often-), second, this, two) time(-s), twice, wheel.

H6465.d: from פָּעַר; a gap; also בַּעַל פְּעוֹר); Peor, a mountain East of Jordan; Baal Peor, (for a deity worshipped there; Peor. See also בֵּית פְּעוֹר.

H6347.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to פֶּחָה; {a prefect (of a city or small district)}; captain, governor.

H6133.d: from עָקַר; figuratively, a transplanted person, i.e. naturalized citizen; stock.

H6469.d: xlit Pᵉullʻthay corrected to Pᵉʻullᵉthay; from פְּעֻלָּה; laborious; Peullethai, an Israelite; Peulthai.

H6372.d: apparently from פֶּה and a variation of נָחָשׁ; mouth of a serpent; Pinechas, the name of three Israelites; Phinehas.

H6046.d: from the dual of עַיִן; two fountains; Anem, a place in Palestine; Anem.

H6301.d: from פָּדָה and צוּר; a rock (i.e. God) has ransomed; Pedahtsur, an Israelite; Pedahzur.

H6224.d: from עֶשֶׂר; tenth; by abbreviation, tenth month or (feminine) part; tenth (part).

H6325.d: from פּוּן; perplexity; Punon, a place in the Desert; Punon.

H6032.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to עָנָה; {properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce}; answer, speak.

H6468.d: feminine passive participle of פָּעַל; (abstractly) work; labour, reward, wages, work.

H6324.d: patronymically from an unused name meaning a turn; a Punite (collectively) or descendants of an unknown Pun; Punites.
